pageDescription: Choose blocks from here when editing a recipe.
deleteConfirm: Delete "{{name}}"? Blocks already added to recipes stay unchanged.
descriptionGeneric: Reusable prompt content for this block.
fieldNotesPlaceholder: When to use it or anything to remember
dialogDescription: A reusable block saved in your palette. Once added to a recipe, it can be edited there.
textEmpty: Add speech, sound, or motion text.
castEmpty: Add a character to this preset.

style.summary: Artist weights, year, quality, and exclusion tags
style.detail: Combine artist tags and weights with year, quality tags, and style exclusions for reuse.

cast.detail: Choose the characters, their placement, and each member's outfit, expression, and negative tags. Multiple characters are sent with a position for each member.
cast.caution: Extra fixed-appearance tags can change a named character. Use fixed traits for OCs.

scene.detail: Describe where and what is happening with short tags or a concise sentence.
examples: a spell begins behind the character

composition.detail: Set how closely and from which angle the subject is framed.

outfit.detail: Choose the character's outfit and visible props. Leaving it empty keeps the character's usual outfit.

expression_pose.detail: Combine facial expression, gaze, hand gestures, and body pose.

lighting.summary: Light direction, type, and screen effects
lighting.detail: Set the light source and mood, along with effects such as motion blur.

motif.detail: Add symbols, props, decorations, and special effects to the image.

text.summary: Dialogue, sound effects, and motion words
text.detail: Add several text entries by kind. Text: entries are appended to the generation prompt; they are not composited as literal lettering onto the image.
text.caution: Keep the text under 750 characters including separator line breaks.

nsfw.detail: Tags for an adult scene. Check the rating and character requirements together.
nsfw.caution: Only adult characters may be used, and the rating must match the content.

negative.detail: Set the rating, base negative preset, and additional negative tags. The allowed range and negative prompt change with the rating.
negative.caution: Higher ratings require the characters to satisfy the age restrictions.

settings.summary: Resolution, steps, scale, sampler, and seed
settings.detail: Set image-generation parameters. A fixed seed helps compare the same input again.
settings.caution: Higher resolution and step counts can increase cost and generation time.
